plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
TREE COMMISSION 
 
REGULAR MEETING AGENDA 
 
5:30 PM, NOVEMBER 17, 2026 
 
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2nd Floor Conference Room 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 
Meeting Agenda: The Tree Commission, Town of Hamden, will hold a Regular Meeting 
on Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 5:30 PM, via Zoom and in person, in the 2nd-Floor 
Conference Room at the Hamden Government Center, 2750 Dixwell Ave, Hamden, CT 
06518. 
  
Comments for this meeting can be made by joining the meeting and participating in the 
public input session. You will have 3 minutes to speak. Or you can write in and send them 
to HBC_Trees@Hamden.com. 
 
Please click the link below to join the webinar: 
https://hamden.zoom.us/j/85483769780 
 
Meeting ID:  854 8376 9780 
Dial In:  +1 646.558.8656 US (New York)  
Participants without Zoom access may still be able to join the meeting (in listen-only mode) 
by (1) dialing the above number, (2) entering the meeting ID: 854 8376 9780, and (3) 
pressing #.  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
 
2. ATTENDANCE 
 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
 
  1. Regular Meeting of October 20, 2026 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT 
 
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.  
6. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)
7. REPORTS 
 
  1. Tree Warden Report (e.g., Removals, Postings, Permits) 
• On-Call Arborist RFP 
 
8. OLD BUSINESS 
 
  1. Trees for Communities Grant 
  2. Tree Inventory 
  3. Activities with Hamden Public Library 
9. NEW BUSINESS 
 
  1. Meeting Agenda Procedures 
10. ADJOURNMENT 
 
  
NOTE: The public may address any item on the agenda of a regular or special meeting and any 
matter within the purview of a Board or Commission at a regular meeting either electronically or 
in person, unless otherwise set forth or constrained by Law of the provisions of this Charter.
